question: Trace reactor-temperature measurement for canonical AssetIdentifier https://aas.example.com/TI101 across six AAS domains: DEXPI function and identifier, ECAD device and local tag, Engineering BOM items, AssetInventory logical asset, ProductCatalog product candidate and physical-installation status, OPC UA operational signal/node and mapping provenance/status. Distinguish verified graph links from provisional or unverified assertions. Also summarize XMEAS9 observations for run 10cfb1d1-2984-4932-8207-dc430ed60c2b between simulation seconds 0 and 600.

attempts.proposal:
SELECT ?asset ?assetIdentifier ?signalReference
WHERE {
  ?asset a <https://example.org/aas/SMC> .
  ?asset <https://example.org/assetinventory/hasAssetIdentifier> ?assetIdentifier .
  ?asset <https://example.org/assetinventory/hasAssetIdentifier> <https://aas.example.com/TI101> .
  ?asset <https://example.org/assetinventory/hasOperationalReference> ?signalReference .
  FILTER (isLiteral(?assetIdentifier) && isLiteral(?signalReference))
}
LIMIT 100
